lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 visible vertical line segments; spacing is relatively consistent across the central torso, narrowing significantly at the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments at the far anterior (shoulder) and far posterior (haunch) positions are significantly abbreviated compared to the central torso lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct white spots visible on the upper posterior flank/hind limb junction.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiraled curvature; initial outward lateral vector from the skull base transitioning to a medial inward curve at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Terminal tip-to-tip distance is approximately 2.6 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total vertical horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between eyes; shaggy dark ventral fringe extending from neck to inguinal region; high-contrast orange-tan distal limb segments.
